claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will take place from April 23–25, 2026.
The 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
The 2026 NFL Draft is a three-day event.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft begins on April 23.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on April 24.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on April 25.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft will be available on ESPN.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft will be available on ABC.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft will be available on the NFL app.
The No. 1 pick in the 2026 NFL Draft is the Las Vegas Raiders.
